Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 150. Category: technique. “Other” Ki Techniques.

Rank 1 ki technique
Ki Cost: 10 ki
Casting Time: 1 action
Prerequisites: Kamehameha or Kamekameha
Range: 10 feet
Chargeable?: No
Duration: 1 Round
Type: Other
The user starts to charge what appears to be the
Kamehameha but instead of a beam a small explosion
of confetti shoots out. The target must make an
intellegence check equal to either your Beam or Omni
save DC or be stunned for the duration.
